name: Calibrated Leaf Area Measurement
description:
Calculate the specific leaf area (SLA) proxy by measuring the total projected area of a leaf blade.

1. Open the built-in 'Leaf' sample image in Fiji (File > Open Samples > Leaf (36K)).

2. Perform Spatial Calibration:
   - The physical width of the image field of view is exactly 10 cm.
   - Use Analyze > Set Scale to calibrate the image global scale based on this width.
   - Ensure the unit is set to 'cm'.

3. Segmentation and Measurement:
   - Threshold the image to isolate the leaf structure.
   - CRITICAL: The measurement must represent the SOLID leaf blade, not just the vein network. You must fill the internal holes in your binary mask (Process > Binary > Fill Holes) before measuring.
   - Measure the Area of the leaf.

4. Save Results:
   - Save the measurement results to '~/ImageJ_Data/results/leaf_area.csv'.
   - The file must contain the Area column with values in square centimeters (cm^2).
